battle.name: 第二次阿散蒂戰爭
battle.theater: 黃金海岸阿莫阿富爾至庫馬西一線
battle.brief: 一八六三年阿散蒂大軍進攻黃金海岸芳蒂諸邦，圍困傳教站；一八六四年一月二十五日英軍在阿莫阿富爾迎戰阿散蒂大軍。卡面的線膛野戰砲代表英軍炮兵的核心火力：數門七磅前裝野戰砲在射程與射速上壓過數萬名持舊式火槍的密集步兵，決定了這場戰役的走向。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰的兩方是阿散蒂帝國與英國一方。阿散蒂帝國以現今加納中部為核心，首都庫馬西，由阿散蒂王統治，國土分為多個省，每省有首長與地方軍，另有由國王直接調動的王家部隊；軍隊以省級師為單位集中，出征時靠臨時徵召的運夫隊與沿途村鎮徵集的糧食維持，武器絕大多數是十七至十八世紀以來從歐洲沿海流入的燧發滑膛槍，並混有長矛、刀與少量舊式小砲。英國一方不是單一常備軍，而是殖民地政府、皇家海軍與英國本土分遣隊拼成的臨時聯盟：開普殖民地總督喬治·格雷爵士決定出兵，總督府提供行政、經費與徵召；皇家海軍好望角分艦隊派出海軍陸戰隊，並用船隻輸送彈藥、糧食與槍械，陸上的骨幹是英國本土團的分遣隊與西印度第一團，另有皇家炮兵連與皇家工兵分隊；受阿散蒂進攻的芳蒂諸邦與阿基姆諸國組成盟友，由受訓的當地民兵提供嚮導、向導與擔夫；內地的傳教團則隨軍撤退或撤往海岸，丟失了前線的傳教站。英方的指揮系統高度集中：遠征總指揮一人掌握全部可用的火砲、糧秣與航路，這在維多利亞時代的海外戰爭中是典型做法，也是這場戰役能以小博大的一方結構性原因。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Asante empire and a British side. The Asante empire had its core in what is now central Ghana, with its capital at Kumasi, ruled by the Asantehene; the country was divided into provinces, each with its own chief and local troops, alongside royal units directly under the king. The army was concentrated into provincial divisions, sustained on campaign by conscripted porter corps and by food requisitioned from the villages along the line of march; the great majority of its weapons were flintlock smoothbore muskets that had flowed in from European coastal trade since the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, mixed with spears, knives and a very few old small cannon. The British side was not a single standing army but an ad hoc coalition of colonial administration, the Royal Navy and detachments from the British Army: Governor Sir George Grey decided on the expedition, and his administration supplied the paperwork, the money and the levies; the Royal Navy's Cape of Good Hope station sent in the Royal Marines and carried ammunition, food and small arms by sea; on land the backbone was detachments from British regiments together with the 1st West India Regiment, plus a Royal Artillery battery and a Royal Engineers detachment. The Fante states, Denkyira and the Akyem polities that had been attacked by the Asante formed the allies, with trained local militia providing guides, scouts and porters. The inland missions retreated with the army or towards the coast, abandoning their forward stations. The British command structure was highly centralised: one expedition commander held all the available guns, food and shipping, which was typical of Victorian overseas war and was the structural reason this campaign could win with so few men.
people: 阿散蒂一方最有決定性的人物是阿散蒂王夸多（Kwadwo），一八三五至一八六七年在位，是一八六三年進攻的發動者；在位時阿散蒂的內陸貿易份額被海岸各邦與阿基姆逐步蠶食，他藉一次大規模出兵試圖重整商路、恢復壯丁徵召的傳統，也藉此鞏固自己在王位上的權威。阿散蒂軍隊的統帥一般認為是阿曼夸·提亞（Amankwah Tia），這位將軍在阿莫阿富爾前線指揮大軍，其後率部退守內陸。英方最關鍵的人物是加尼特·約瑟夫·沃爾斯利：出發時他只是陸軍中校，因戰功與閣僚支持而被越級授予少將，一八六四年一月的遠征由他一人統率，他把一支數百人的分遣隊擴成以海軍陸戰隊與西印度第一團為骨幹的遠征軍，並且用封鎖、破壞與逼和取代了硬攻庫馬西。他的上司、開普殖民地總督喬治·格雷是出兵的政治推手，正是格雷在倫敦猶豫時逕行決定動武。英方前線還有海軍陸戰隊隊長與西印度第一團的指揮官在阿莫阿富爾一線輪流掌握前線節奏。另一批在戰史上留下名字的人，是受圍的衛理公會傳教團與其本地信眾：阿貝蒂菲傳教站被圍數週而始終沒有淪陷，是輿情轉向的關鍵；而把英國公眾注意力拉回本土的，還有在加納海岸服務的醫生與傳教士寫成的通訊、請願與演說，其中把黑人士兵與混血助手寫成英雄的敘述，在維多利亞時代的英國引起廣泛共鳴。
peopleEn: The decisive figure on the Asante side was the Asantehene Kwadwo, who reigned from 1835 to 1867 and was the man who set the 1863 invasion in motion. In his reign the Asante share of the interior trade was being eaten away by the coastal states and by the Akyem; he used one large offensive to try to re-order the trade routes, to restore the old tradition of recruiting labour and soldiers, and to shore up his own authority on the throne. The Asante army is generally credited to the command of Amankwah Tia, who led the host in the front line at Amoaful and afterwards withdrew with it into the interior. The key figure on the British side was Garnet Joseph Wolseley. He left as a lieutenant-colonel, was promoted to major-general on the strength of the campaign and the backing of the ministry, and from January 1864 he commanded the whole expedition, expanding a detachment of some hundreds into a field army built on the Royal Marines and the 1st West India Regiment, and choosing blockade, destruction and negotiation in place of an assault on Kumasi. His superior, Governor of the Cape Colony Sir George Grey, was the political engine of the intervention, for it was Grey who decided on war while London hesitated. On the British front line the command of the fighting at Amoaful passed between the commander of the Royal Marines and the officer commanding the 1st West India Regiment. Another set of names in the record belongs to the Church Missionary Society missionaries and their local converts at the besieged station of Abetifi: the mission did not fall, and that was the turning point in public opinion; and what brought the issue home to the British public were the letters, petitions and lectures of doctors and missionaries serving on the Gold Coast, whose accounts of black soldiers and mixed-race assistants as heroes struck a wide responsive note in Victorian Britain.
kits: 卡面這件線膛野戰砲代表的是野戰砲兵在這場戰爭裡的位置。英軍的火力骨幹是皇家炮兵連攜帶的前裝七磅野戰砲：這是英國一八五〇年代定裝的野戰砲，以人力與少量馬匹拖曳，能發射霰彈、霰彈加榴彈，射程約一千二百至一千四百碼，每分鐘可發六至八發，射速與射程都在阿散蒂火槍之上數倍。英國陸軍到一八六三年仍以滑膛前裝野戰砲為主，線膛裝藥與阿姆斯特朗後膛砲只剛開始少量裝備；德國方面，克里普在威爾肖一八五〇年前後已能整體鑄出大型鋼砲，線膛與後膛技術的成熟把野戰砲推上了世代更替的路口。卡面所繪的線膛砲正站在這個更替點上：它把同樣藥量的射程再推遠，使砲兵第一次可以在射程上正面贏過密集步兵。阿散蒂一方則幾乎沒有炮兵：全軍只有數門由歐洲流入的舊式滑膛鑄鐵小砲，射程短、射速低，沒有成建制的炮兵連，也沒有任何攻城器材；士兵的主要火力是進口或繳獲的燧發滑膛槍，一部分人只拿長矛與短刀。因此一八六四年一月二十五日的阿莫阿富爾之戰，實質是數門野戰砲對數萬支射程不足的舊火槍。運輸與補給同樣失衡：英軍靠海軍船運糧秣、靠徵來的擔夫與牛車騾車維持縱隊，縱隊一旦離開海岸道路，補給就成了一道死結；阿散蒂的糧食靠戰前城鎮的囤積與臨時徵收，一旦英軍深入、破壞村落，前線立刻缺糧。
kitsEn: The rifled field gun on this card stands for the place of field artillery in this war. The backbone of British firepower was the Royal Artillery's muzzle-loading seven-pounder field gun, the standard British piece of the 1850s: it was drawn by men and a few horses, fired canister, shrapnel and combinations of the two, reached roughly twelve hundred to fourteen hundred yards and could fire six to eight rounds a minute, giving it both range and rate of fire several times over the Asante muskets. As late as 1863 the British Army was still overwhelmingly equipped with smoothbore muzzle-loading field guns, while rifled loading and the Armstrong breech-loader were only beginning to appear in small numbers; in Germany, Krupp was already casting large steel guns integrally at the Wesel works in the mid-1850s, and the maturing of rifling and breech loading was pushing field guns into a new generation. The rifled gun on this card stands exactly at that transition: it carries the same charge further, and for the first time let artillery beat massed infantry on range. The Asante had virtually no artillery at all: the whole army possessed perhaps a handful of old smoothbore cast-iron pieces from European trade, short-ranged and slow-firing, with no organised artillery companies and no siege material whatsoever. The main armament of the Asante soldier was the imported or captured flintlock smoothbore musket, and some men carried only spears and knives. The battle of Amoaful on 25 January 1864 was therefore, in substance, a handful of field guns against tens of thousands of old muskets that could not reach them. Transport and supply were as uneven as the weapons: the British relied on naval shipping for food and powder, on conscripted porters and on bullock and mule carts to keep the column moving, and once the column left the coastal roads supply became a fixed constraint; the Asante drew food from town depots filled before the campaign and from requisition on the spot, so as soon as the British pushed inland and burned the villages, the forward echelon went hungry.
tactics: 英軍的戰法是用火砲射程換取主動權。遠征隊自一八六四年一月初在開普海岸上岸後，選擇由阿莫阿富爾通往庫馬西的南北向道路作主軸，行軍縱隊以營地形式宿營並設路旁哨，砲兵與工兵隨縱隊前進，儘量不讓砲車離開視界。面對阿散蒂大軍的密集推進，英軍選擇在開闊地與半林地交接處佈防：步兵以散兵線與側翼縱隊牽制，中央把數門七磅砲架在可通視的地面，待阿散蒂大軍進入射程才開始射擊；阿散蒂密集的縱隊在火砲與連發步槍前被迫停下，陣形一旦鬆散便被英軍步兵反衝打散。攻擊得手後英軍不戀戰，立刻鞏固阿莫阿富爾，再以分隊沿兩側村鎮推進，毀掉沿途的糧倉、奪取或燒掉對方的物資，切斷庫馬西與南部產金區之間的道路。阿散蒂方面以人海與地利對抗：把數萬名士兵以師為單位密集投入，在土壘、倒木與村寨背後以散兵線射擊，再以整隊衝鋒試圖把英軍陣線壓垮；同時在森林中以小股游擊擾亂英軍的糧車隊與哨兵，焚燒沿線村莊以斷糧。英軍真正的限制不是火力而是補給與攻城能力：沒有攻城砲便無法攻破庫馬西的土牆與護城壕溝，縱隊的糧草一旦拉長便難以為繼，這正是戰局未能變成攻城戰的技術原因。
tacticsEn: The British method was to trade the reach of the guns for the initiative. After landing on the coast in early January 1864, the expedition took the north-south road from Amoaful towards Kumasi as its axis; the column bivouacked in order, with outposts on the flanks of the road, and the artillery and engineers moved with the column, the guns kept as close to view as possible. Against the dense advance of the Asante host, the British chose ground where open country met half-cleared woodland: the infantry held in skirmish order with the flanks tied forward to contain the enemy, while the centre unlimbered several seven-pounders on ground with clear field of fire and waited for the Asante masses to come within range before opening fire. The packed Asante columns were checked dead by the guns and the repeating muskets, and once their order loosened the British infantry charged and scattered them. Having gained the action, the British did not press: they at once consolidated Amoaful, then pushed detachments along the villages on both flanks, burning depots and stores and cutting the road between Kumasi and the gold-bearing country to the south. The Asante answered with numbers and with ground: they fed tens of thousands of men into the attack division by division, fired in skirmish order from behind earthen works, felled trees and village walls, and then launched formed charges to try to crush the thin British line; in the forest they also ran small bands against the baggage carts and pickets, burning the villages along the road to starve the column. The real British limitation was not firepower but supply and the ability to besiege: with no siege guns there was no way through the earthen walls and ditch of Kumasi, and once the column's food had to be stretched the advance could not be sustained. That, more than any lack of men, is the technical reason the campaign never became an assault on the capital.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下：阿散蒂的進攻始於一八六三年，英方遠征的核心戰事集中在長約四個月的一八六四年一月至五月。決戰爆發於一月二十五日，即阿莫阿富爾之戰；英軍在兩日後的二十七日佔領該鎮，隨後推進至安科布拉與阿丹西一線，逼近庫馬西而終未進城，遠征隊五月撤出。英軍出動兵力約一千五百至一千八百人，其中海軍陸戰隊與西印度第一團是骨幹，另有英國本土團的分遣隊、皇家炮兵與皇家工兵；阿散蒂方面，英方估計大軍約二萬五千人，但實際到場與能投入攻擊的數目，各家說法從一萬多到四萬不等。損失方面，英方戰報稱己方陣亡二十餘人、受傷約一百五十上下；阿散蒂方面的陣亡沒有可靠統計，英方宣稱以千計。一八六三年十一月至十二月，阿貝蒂菲傳教站被圍約一個月，最後由海軍陸戰隊與西印度第一團的小分隊解圍。地距上，由開普海岸到阿莫阿富爾約三十公里，由阿莫阿富爾至庫馬西的實際行軍路線約二百至二百五十公里。一八六四年春末，遠征營地爆發霍亂，造成大量非戰鬥減員，這與糧秣不足一同決定了英軍的推進極限。英方開出的賠款以英鎊計，數目在往來照會中反覆爭議，最後以分期方式認定，並未全額繳清。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The Asante offensive began in 1863, while the main British campaign ran through the better part of four months, from January to May 1864. The decisive action came on 25 January, the battle of Amoaful; the British occupied the town on the 27th, advanced as far as the Ankobra and Adansi lines, closed on Kumasi without ever entering it, and withdrew in May. The British force numbered about fifteen hundred to eighteen hundred men, the backbone being the Royal Marines and the 1st West India Regiment, with detachments from British regiments, Royal Artillery and Royal Engineers, and only a handful of guns. On the Asante side the British estimated the host at some twenty-five thousand men, though accounts of how many actually arrived and could be committed to the attack run from a little over ten thousand to forty thousand. In losses the British dispatch claimed about twenty men killed and roughly a hundred and fifty wounded; there is no reliable figure for Asante dead, though the British claimed thousands. Between November and December 1863 the mission station at Abetifi was besieged for about a month and was relieved by a small force of Royal Marines and 1st West India Regiment. In distances, roughly thirty kilometres separate the coast from Amoaful, and the line actually marched from Amoaful towards Kumasi was some two hundred to two hundred and fifty kilometres. In late spring 1864 cholera broke out in the expedition camp, causing heavy non-combat attrition, which together with short supplies set the limit of the British advance. The indemnity demanded was reckoned in pounds sterling; the figure was argued back and forth in the correspondence and was eventually agreed in instalments, and it was never paid in full.
cause: 打起上來的直接原因，是阿散蒂在內陸的貿易地位於十九世紀五十至六十年代被架空。一八五〇年代起，黃金海岸的黃金貿易路線由從內陸經安科布拉出海的舊路，逐步轉向由阿基姆與南部諸邦直通海岸的新路，阿散蒂失去了作為中間商的主要收入與壟斷；沿海的芳蒂諸邦與阿基姆在英國保護與傳教團協助下日益獨立，阿散蒂傳統的徵貢要求越來越少被承認。阿散蒂王夸多決心用一次大規模出兵改變這一格局：一八六三年初大軍進攻芳蒂與阿基姆諸國，席捲村落、擄走居民與財物，圍困傳教站，並在開普海岸一帶修築砲台與營壘，直接威脅到傳教團、殖民地商站與英國僑民的安全，迫使原本傾向退讓的英國輿情在一八六三年秋冬間急轉，殖民地總督喬治·格雷終於決定出兵。深層原因還有阿散蒂內部的權力結構：國王與大酋長會議之間、以及與省級勢力之間的矛盾，使夸多需要一場對外勝利來鞏固自己的位置；而英方則把這次出兵視為避免重演一八二〇年代那種沿海英僑聚落被攻掠的必須防範，也視為把英國在黃金海岸的權威從海岸推入內陸的機會。於是，本地商路與教權衝突、王位聲望的計算，以及歐洲列強在非洲的殖民警戒，三股力量在一八六三年冬天匯合成一場開火。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the hollowing out of the Asante interior trade position during the 1850s and 1860s. From the 1850s the route by which gold reached the Atlantic shifted away from the old inland path out through Ankobra towards a new one running directly from the Akyem and the southern states to the coast, and the Asante lost the bulk of the middleman's profit and monopoly. The coastal Fante, Denkyira and Akyem states, backed by British protection and by the missions, grew steadily more independent, and fewer and fewer Asante tribute claims were acknowledged. The Asantehene Kwadwo resolved to change this with one large offensive: in early 1863 the host struck into the Fante and Akyem countries, swept through the villages, carried off people and goods, besieged the mission stations and built redoubts and camps along the Cape Coast, so that the missions, the colonial trading posts and British residents were directly menaced. British opinion, which had been inclined to give way, turned sharply during the autumn and winter of 1863, and Governor Sir George Grey finally decided to intervene. Deeper causes lie in the internal structure of Asante power: the frictions between the king and the council of great chiefs, and between the crown and the provincial houses, meant that Kwadwo needed an external victory to make his own position secure. For the British, the expedition was at once a necessary guard against a repetition of the raids on British settlements of the 1820s and an opportunity to push British authority on the Gold Coast from the coast into the interior. A local quarrel over trade and missions, a calculation about the prestige of a throne, and the colonial vigilance of the European powers in Africa thus merged into a single outbreak in the winter of 1863.
impact: 影響至少有五層。第一，軍事技術層面，這場戰爭是一次教科書式的示範：數門野戰砲、數百名受訓步兵與一條可靠的海運補給線，足以擊退數萬人的非洲軍隊，並迫使一個佔據黃金海岸腹地的大國接受苛刻條件；在此之後，歐洲對非洲的軍事計劃普遍更倚重火砲、鐵路與後勤，而不是人數與膽量。第二，帝國內部層面，賠款與歸還被擄人口的要求，加上英軍一度進抵庫馬西郊的羞辱，使阿散蒂西部的臣屬與商路進一步脫離中央，夸多在王位上的聲望嚴重受損；一八六七年他被廢黜，繼承者未能扭轉弱勢，一八七三年英國以索取金凳為由再度開戰，庫馬西在次年被攻陷並遭洗掠——第二次阿散蒂戰爭的結果，正是第三次戰爭的起因。第三，殖民制度層面，英國在黃金海岸的保護範圍由海岸推向內陸，一八七四年保護國建立後，沿海城市與內陸產金區之間的權力重心被重新分配，阿散蒂的中介貿易網絡逐步瓦解。第四，英國國內政治層面，衛理公會與其他傳教團的傳教士成為民族英雄，圍困傳教站的消息與黑人士兵、混血傳教士在戰場上的表現引發一場關於海外干預的公開辯論，沃爾斯利也由一名中校躍升為全國知名的將軍，其後一路升到英軍總參謀長。第五，這場戰爭為後來的殖民政權提供了一套治理敘事：以恢復秩序、保護傳教團為名取得內陸通行權，再以賠款、割地與和平條約的形式把取得的東西固定下來，其模式在此後二十年的西非政策中不斷重演。
impactEn: The consequences work out on at least five levels. First, at the level of military technique, the war was a textbook demonstration: a handful of field guns, several hundred trained infantry and one reliable sea-borne supply line were enough to defeat an African army numbering tens of thousands and to force a great power occupying the interior of the Gold Coast onto harsh terms; from then on European plans for Africa leaned far more on artillery, railways and logistics than on numbers and boldness. Second, at the level of the empire's interior, the indemnity and the demand for the return of captives, together with the humiliation of seeing British troops approach Kumasi, loosened the western provinces and the trade routes from the centre and left Kwadwo's standing badly damaged; he was deposed in 1867, his successor could not reverse the trend, and in 1873 Britain went to war again over the Golden Stool, taking Kumasi and sacking it the following year. The outcome of the second Asante war was, in other words, the cause of the third. Third, at the level of colonial institutions, the range of British protection on the Gold Coast was pushed from the coast into the interior, and after the protectorate was established in 1874 the balance of power between the coastal towns and the gold-bearing interior was redistributed and the Asante brokerage network was gradually dismantled. Fourth, at the level of British domestic politics, the missionaries of the Church Missionary Society and the other societies became national heroes, the news of the besieged stations and the conduct of black soldiers and mixed-race missionaries in the field set off a public debate about overseas intervention, and Wolseley went from lieutenant-colonel to a general famous throughout the country and eventually on to the command of the British Army. Fifth, the war furnished the coming colonial government with a governing narrative: the right of entry into the interior was obtained in the name of restoring order and protecting the missions, and what had been taken was then fixed in the form of indemnities, cessions and treaties of peace, a pattern that went on repeating itself through the western African policy of the following twenty years.
result: 結果是英方以極小的代價換到最大的政治成果，但沒有攻取庫馬西，也沒有廢黜阿散蒂王。一八六四年一月二十五日阿莫阿富爾之戰後，阿散蒂大軍退回內陸，英軍在二十七日未遇抵抗地佔領該鎮，隨後推進到能俯瞰庫馬西的方向；英方沒有攻城砲，火砲射程也只及於城外的一道斜坡，因此改以封鎖商路、破壞村鎮、扣留人質與等待賠款的方式施壓。結果在四月的談判中成形：阿散蒂同意歸還被擄走的居民與英軍被擄的士兵、交付一批人質作保、並以英鎊計支付賠款；英方隨後取得阿散蒂各部族酋長的簽名作為憑據，於一八六四年五月撤出，遠征隊在沒有再打一場大仗的情況下回到海岸。一八六五年起，英方海軍開始砲擊海岸沿線由阿散蒂修築的砲台，把阿散蒂在海岸的存在逐步清除；阿散蒂也曾就英軍造成的損失向英國法院提出索賠，結果未獲支持。戰爭的直接結果因此是一個沒有勝負的勝負：阿散蒂帝國依然存在，夸多依然坐在王座上，但它的西面邊境、它的商路、以及它的軍隊在野外的作戰能力，都已被證明不足以對抗配備野戰砲的專業部隊；英國則用一支不到兩千人的遠征軍，在黃金海岸內陸取得了一個可以隨時重來的打開局面，卻沒有花力氣去完成它——正因為沒有完成，一八七三年才會有那場以金凳為名的第三次戰爭。
resultEn: The result was that the British bought the largest political result at the smallest cost, while taking neither Kumasi nor the Asantehene's throne. After the battle of Amoaful on 25 January 1864 the Asante host withdrew into the interior, the British occupied the town unopposed on the 27th, and the advance continued to the point from which Kumasi could be looked down upon. With no siege guns, and with the guns reaching only a slope outside the town, the British changed method and applied pressure by cutting the trade roads, destroying the villages, holding hostages and waiting out the indemnity. The shape of the outcome was settled in the negotiations of April: the Asante undertook to return the people they had carried off and the British soldiers they held, to give a number of hostages as security, and to pay an indemnity reckoned in pounds sterling. The British gathered the signatures of the Asante chiefs of the several divisions as their warrant, and in May 1864 withdrew, the expedition returning to the coast without having fought another pitched battle. From 1865 the British navy began bombarding the redoubts the Asante had built along the coast, clearing the Asante presence off the shore by degrees; the Asante also brought a claim for the damage done by the British to the courts in England, and it was not upheld. The direct result was therefore a victory without a battle: the Asante empire still stood and Kwadwo still sat on his stool, but its western frontier, its trade routes and the field performance of its army had all been shown unequal to a professional force equipped with field artillery. Britain, for its part, had opened a position in the interior of the Gold Coast with fewer than two thousand men and had not troubled to make it permanent; and precisely because it did not, there would be a third war in 1873, fought over the Golden Stool.
